method: Built-in ImageGen using v6 SketchUp exported elevations and material change log

jobs.prompt: Use case sketch-to-render. Input is authoritative JESB LOT20 V6 Front SketchUp elevation. Render photorealistically with exact original architecture, camera straight-on ORTHOGRAPHIC, every window position/count/shape, roof profile, material boundary and downspout placement preserved. Front: FOUR small upper windows above garage in TWO separated PAIRS, narrow BLACK infill between each pair. Keep all four distinct panes. Smooth seamless white Hardie in garage tall-window bay and bays beside stone entrance. TWO large single-piece seamless black panels between triple windows, plus BLACK panel directly above entry doors below entry window and black infill between three stacked windows. Pale natural stone entrance. Black gutters/downspouts exactly as shown. Preserve revised garage roof profile. ALL windows have NO projecting sills. No soldier courses, no decorative bands or frieze added. All BLACK and WHITE Hardie architectural panels smooth seamless flat surfaces, NO joint lines, NO horizontal lap siding. Preserve existing VERTICAL board-and-batten elsewhere. Materials model palette: off-white fine brick, pale off-white natural stone, Arctic White Hardie RGB241,242,237, matte black Hardie RGB38,38,40, charcoal shingles, black aluminum frames/doors/5-inch gutters/3x4-inch downspouts; narrow white fascia beneath black gutters. Soft bright daylight, blue sky with subtle clouds, realistic reflective glazing. Trees only far distant low background sides. Wide ~2.1:1, whole building large, modest sky. Ground is only thin horizontal line at very bottom, no broad foreground pavement/grass or blank band. No people, cars, shrubs, text, watermark. Do not redesign or reuse older geometry.
